ayahs.1: Yaqeenan hum ne ise Shab-e-Qadr mein naazil farmaya.
ayahs.2: To kya samjha ke Shab-e-Qadr kya hai?
ayahs.3: Shab-e-Qadr ek hazaar maheenon se behtar hai.
ayahs.4: Is (mein har kaam) ke sar-anjaam dene ko apne Rabb ke hukm se farishte aur Rooh (Jibrail) utarte hain.
ayahs.5: Yeh raat saraasar salaamati ki hoti hai aur fajr ke tuloo hone tak (rehti hai).
